profile.headline: Payments @ Stripe | 2x founder | 3x startup CTO
profile.summary:
Software engineer and entrepreneur; founded companies in political data aggregation, educational games, and online music rhythm gaming as a platform for distribution and engagement.

Passionate about innovative products, regardless of industry or technology, and applying specialized expertise to bridge gaps between business strategy, technology, and outcomes, in both new product development and core business optimization.

Specialties: scalable, reliable, and efficient architectures; distributed systems; write-heavy workloads. Experience with scale: data stores with billions of records, install bases of O(100M), DAUs of O(10M), concurrent users of O(100K).

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently Product Architect and Technical Lead for Payments, focused on the vision, architecture, and execution of Stripe’s anchor payment products. 

Previously worked across the payments stack, including service architecture and performance, financial partner integrations, internal platforms, user-facing payments APIs, and data pipelines.

positions.title: CTO
positions.description:
Worked with creative and product leads to bring an idea from concept to market: a platform for interactive entertainment, enabling broadcasters to engage their audiences with real-time interactions and game developers to design viewer-centric experiences. Also, building the services and infrastructure for the global launch of a multiplayer PC game, SOS.

As technical lead – design, decisions, and development of front-end (React SPAs), back-end (API layer, distributed systems, data pipelines), and devops (AWS infrastructure, ci/cd, monitoring, etc).

As team lead – recruiting, hiring (positions, process, decisions), and managing the platform engineering team.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Led engineering teams through pre-production, launch, and stable live operations, including the flagship FarmVille. 

Accountable for client and server architecture, infrastructure, performance, scalability, security, tools, and overall game and code quality. Responsible for netops cost management (including MMs in infra cost savings), evaluating and mitigating technical risk to project timelines, technical mentorship, and managing technical staff.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech Lead for performance and feature engineering pods on Farmville. Directly responsible for metrics-driven optimization of load time, client frame rate, and in-game interactions. Solutions included novel applications of asset caching (later adopted widely at Zynga for web-based games), patch versioning, and spatial data structures to enable innovative game mechanics.

positions.title: Co-Founder and CTO
positions.description:
Created JamLegend.com, a destination for music rhythm gaming and discovery with over 2M users. JamLegend featured partnerships with major music labels, supported self-published albums by independent artists, and unlocked your entire iTunes library for gaming. 

Key roles in product concept, design, and development, as well as business strategy, hiring, and management.

Acquired by Zynga in 2011.

positions.title: Co-Founder and CTO
positions.description: Created three political technology products: FantasyCongress.com (fantasy sports meets civics education), Politico's Kingmaker (2008 election predictions game, in partnership with Politico.com), and PoliQuiz (embedded political polling widget, in partnership with the SunlightFoundation.org). Responsible for development, design, testing, technical ops and business strategy.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Philosophy, Politics and Economics, secondary concentration in Computer Science
